title: DreamMusicForge Provider-Specific Production Package
description: Output of the provider translation layer (pipeline's final stage). Translates the provider-neutral Cinematic and Musical Architecture documents into one video provider's and one music provider's prompt format, plus a Monte Carlo estimate of generation risk. A provider's rendering of a shot is one interface onto the canonical spec, not a replacement for it -- the Cinematic/Musical/Editorial documents remain the source of truth; a provider's specific output is not treated as more authoritative than they are.

selected_video_provider.description: Not locked to an enum -- the provider layer is deliberately provider-neutral and providers churn. Documented candidates as of this writing: Google Veo, Runway, Luma AI Dream Machine, Pika, Kling AI.

selected_music_provider.description: Documented candidates as of this writing: Suno, Udio.

video_prompts.description: One entry per shot in the paired Cinematic Architecture. Every shot_id must be covered (checked by validate_against_cinematic_architecture).

source_fields_used.description: Which Cinematic Architecture fields this prompt was actually derived from -- a traceability gate against inventing creative content that isn't in the canonical spec.

generation_risk_estimate.description: A Monte Carlo simulation of how many generation attempts the full shot list is likely to need, modeling per-shot pass probability as uniformly uncertain within a range (same technique as estimating whether two tasks with uncertain durations finish before a deadline) and per-shot retries as geometric. Re-derivable: validate_provider_specific_production_package() reruns the simulation from the stored parameters and checks the stored estimate is reproducible, not hand-typed.

contains.const: This kernel does not claim to guarantee any specific viewer belief, emotion, or decision.
